evidence: In this study, an AD mouse model was established through lateral ventricular injection of amyloid-beta1–42 (Aβ1–42).
Subsequently, adeno-associated virus was administered to overexpress SFPQ in the hippocampus of AD mice.
The results demonstrate that SFPQ overexpression improves recognition and memory in AD mice
role_coverage.label: Mice
paragraphs: Mice provide the experimental setting: the authors establish an AD mouse model and use it to assess hippocampal SFPQ overexpression and cognitive and memory outcomes. The abstract reports improved recognition and memory in AD mice.

evidence: Diabetes mellitus (DM), a most common chronic disease, is featured with impaired endothelial function and bioavailability of nitric oxide (NO)
Herein, we aimed to determine whether E3 ubiquitin ligase casitas B-lineage lymphoma (Cbl) alleviates endothelial dysfunction in DM rats by JAK2/STAT4 pathway.
role_coverage.label: impaired
paragraphs: “Impaired” describes endothelial function in diabetes mellitus, framing the endothelial dysfunction the authors investigate in relation to Cbl.

evidence: Herein, we aimed to determine whether E3 ubiquitin ligase casitas B-lineage lymphoma (Cbl) alleviates endothelial dysfunction in DM rats by JAK2/STAT4 pathway.
role_coverage.label: rats
paragraphs: The mention of rats identifies the animal-model context for the study’s question of whether Cbl alleviates endothelial dysfunction in DM through the JAK2/STAT4 pathway.

evidence: A rat model of DM was developed through intraperitoneal injection of streptozotocin, followed by collection of aortic tissues to determine the expression of Cbl, JAK2, runt-related transcription factor 3 (Runx3) and STAT4.
Cbl was reduced in DM rat tissues and HG-induced HUVECs, where JAK2, Runx3 and STAT4 were elevated.
role_coverage.label: rat
paragraphs: The rat is the in vivo DM model used for aortic-tissue expression measurements; the abstract also reports findings in DM rat tissues.

evidence: Mechanistically, Cb1 enhanced JAK2 ubiquitination and decreased JAK2 and STAT4 expression, where STAT4 improved Runx3 expression by regulating histone H3 lysine 4 trimethylation level.
Overexpression of JAK2 and STAT4, or Runx3 increased apoptosis of HUVECs, abrogating the effect of Cb1 on endothelial function.
In conclusion, Cbl alleviates endothelial dysfunction by inactivation of the JAK2/STAT4 pathway and inhibition of Runx3 expression in DM.
role_coverage.label: runt-related transcription factor 3
paragraphs: Runx3 is examined as part of the proposed mechanism: the authors report that STAT4 increased Runx3 expression by regulating histone H3 lysine 4 trimethylation and conclude that Cbl inhibits Runx3 expression. They also report that Runx3 overexpression increased HUVEC apoptosis and abrogated Cbl’s effect on endothelial function.

evidence: Human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs) were cultured in high glucose (HG) condition to induce DM as an in vitro model.
role_coverage.label: Human
paragraphs: “Human” supplies the species context for the in vitro model: the authors cultured human umbilical vein endothelial cells under high glucose to induce DM in vitro.

evidence: strongly impaired tumor-initiating capacity in a re-implantation mouse model
role_coverage.label: mouse
paragraphs: The mouse is the in vivo model context for assessing tumor-initiating capacity; the abstract reports this capacity in a re-implantation mouse model.

paragraphs: Human CRC specimens provide the source for gene-expression data used in the study's analysis of EZH2 and CCS-like cell properties.

which indicated the PI3K/protein kinase B (AKT) might be the critical component of the PTEN effects during serum deficiency.

paragraphs: The authors investigate serum deprivation in H9c2 cells as a condition for modeling myocardial-infarction apoptosis. They report PTEN effects during serum deficiency and identify PI3K/AKT as a possible critical component.
